maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from LINZESS (linaclotide) prescription drug sales and collaboration with AbbVie, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: LINZESS is paid for by a mix of commercial insurers, Medicare Part D and patients; no clear government majority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grew by discovering and developing LINZESS in-house, commercialized with AbbVie, not by a stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Revenue relies on LINZESS for IBS-C and chronic constipation; other prescription therapies exist, so switching is feasible.

notes: Government payer share (Medicare Part D) of LINZESS is uncertain; mission-critical is a judgment call.
